answer_1.quote: We present KMI, a dataset of 1,000 Korean Motivational Interviewing dialogues...

answer_4.quote: We recruited four Korean psychological counseling experts... The experts are then requested to evaluate the dialogues based on the criteria defined in Section 4.1, using a Likert scale ranging from 1 to 5.
answer_4.guideline: Evaluate the dialogues based on the criteria defined in Section 4.1 using a 5-point Likert scale.
